subject: general
question:
Find the capacity of a spherical container of thickness 2 cm and external radius 9 cm. (Rounded off to 2 decimal places.)

(Use pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

The external radius of sphere = 9 cm

The thickness of the shell = 2 cm

Internal radius of shell = (9-2) cm = 7 cm 

**Concept used:**

The volume of sphere = {4over3}pi r³

**Calculations:**

** V **= {4over3}times{22over7}×7×7×7

 V = 4312over3

 V = 1437.33 cm³

**∴ The correct option is 1437.33 cm3 .**
